sections.heading: Legal Representatives
sections.text:
Below is a summary of the resumes of BBVA Colombia's legal representatives that have been published in the RNVE to date:
Juan Maria Canel - Executive Vice President of the Financial Area
Age Range: 35 – 45 years old
With over 17 years of experience in the financial industry, he has developed a solid and diverse career in key markets such as Brazil, Spain, Argentina, and Colombia, also participating in strategic projects in other countries in Europe and Latin America. His experience spans areas such as Strategy, Finance, Risk, and Business, including Commercial Banking, Payments, and Treasury. A certified public accountant by training, he holds a Master's degree in Finance, CFA certification, knowledge of data analysis, and leadership skills acquired at institutions such as Harvard Business School. He has held senior positions in renowned financial institutions, including CFO at Itaú Colombia and executive roles at Santander in various regions.
Olga Lucía Calzada Estupiñan – Executive Vice President of Legal Services and General Secretary
Age Range 45 – 55 years old
Lawyer graduated from the Faculty of Law and Legal Sciences at the “Universidad Nacional de Colombia”, with a specialization in Financial Legislation from the “Universidad de los Andes”. With over 25 years of experience, she has held roles such as General Secretary and Legal and Compliance Vice President at Bancamía S.A., Head of the Special Legal Advisory Area at BBVA Colombia, Legal Vice President and General Secretary at Banco Granahorrar S.A., General Secretary at the “Fondo de Garantías de Instituciones Financieras” (FOGAFIN), and Legal Director at the same entity. She has also served as an advisor at the Ministries of Justice and Law, and Finance and Public Credit, and has been a board member of various financial entities. Currently, she serves as the Executive Vice President of Legal Services and General Secretary.
Alberto Parra Alonso – Executive Vice President, Talent and Culture
Age Range 55 – 65 years old
Professional in Business Science from the Vicalvaro University; with courses in Development in Management from the IESE and Coaching from the “Escuela Europea de Coaching”, Madrid. He has more than 22 years of experience in personnel management in the BBVA Group, where he has served as Personnel Manager and Human Resources Manager Spain and Portugal in BBVA Madrid. Additionally he has served as Talent and Culture Director. Since 2019 to February 2023, he was Vice President of Talent and Culture in Uruguay. He currently serves as Talent and Culture Vice President in BBVA Colombia.
Pablo Andrés García – Executive Vice President of the Risk Area
Bachelor's degree in Economics, a Master's in Finance from Universidad del Salvador in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and an MBA in Finance from New York University. He has over 20 years of experience, having worked at Lloyd’s Bank TSB Bs As Argentina as a Retail and SME Business Officer, managing commercial relations with clients. Pablo joined the BBVA Group in 2005 at BBVA Argentina in Global Risk Management. He also worked for a year at BBVA Spain as a participant in the comprehensive credit risk and global management training program at the School of Finance. He returned to Argentina as a Senior Retail Risk Analyst. In 2010, he moved to Spain as the Global Risk Management officer for South America. In 2017, he worked in Peru as the Global Risk Management - Risk Manager. In 2021, he was appointed Chief Risk Officer at BBVA Forum Financial Services.
Sergio Andrés Lizarazo Lizarazo - Executive Vice President of Enterprise and Government Banking
Economist from Universidad de Los Andes, with a master’s in administration from Universidad Ecesi and Master of Management Tulane University. With more than 10 years of experience in the financial sector where he has held positions as Account Manager at Corpbanca Bank; Relationship Manager at Citibank, Segment Leader at Scotiabank and is currently the Director of Corporate Banking at BBVA Colombia.
Maria Catalina Laurens Acevedo - Executive Vice President of Corporate Investment Banking
María Catalina is a professional with over twenty years of experience in international banking. She has held leadership positions at institutions such as Banco Santander, where she was responsible for CIB Colombia, in addition to other senior roles at HSBC and Citibank Colombia. She currently serves as Vice President of Corporate Investment Banking at BBVA Colombia.
Sergio Miguel Rojas Munita – Executive Vice President of Retail Banking
Age Range: 55 – 65 years
Agricultural Engineer with a specialization in Economics from Universidad de Concepción (Chile), holds a Master’s degree in Financial Management from Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez (Chile) and a Master’s degree in Fintech and Digital Financial Services from IEBS Business School (Spain). He brings extensive experience in the financial sector, having held positions such as Assistant Manager of Middle Market Retail Banking at Itaú, Retail Banking Manager at Itaú, and Vice President of the Branch Network and Private Banking at the same institution. He currently serves as Executive Vice President of Retail Banking at BBVA Colombia.
Katherine Duque Quiroga - Executive Vice President of Engineering
Age Range: 40 - 50 years
Systems and Computer Engineer graduated from Universidad del Quindío, holding a specialization in Engineering Management Systems from Pontificia Universidad Javeriana. She brings over 17 years of experience leading technological transformation processes in the financial sector. Throughout her career, she has held leadership positions at Scotiabank Colpatria and BBVA Colombia, directing initiatives in digital innovation, banking modernization, artificial intelligence, and financial business evolution. She currently serves as Executive Vice President of Engineering at BBVA Colombia.
Rubén Darío Núñez Mejía - Director of Premises & Services
Industrial Engineer from Universidad América, with specializations in Management Systems Engineering from Universidad Javeriana, Finance, and Capital Markets from Universidad del Rosario, and a master’s degree in business administration from Universidad Sergio Arboleda. With over 29 years of experience in the financial sector, he joined BBVA Colombia in 2001, where he has served as Manager of Control and Compensation, Manager of Employee Management, and currently as Director of Premises & Services.
Alexandra Romero Romero - Director of Compensation and Benefits
Psychologist with a Master’s degree in Business Administration from Universidad Sergio Arboleda and Northern Illinois University. She has over 28 years of experience in Human Resource Management. Since 2010, she has been with BBVA Colombia, where she has held various positions within the Talent and Culture Vice Presidency.
Ronal Edgardo Saavedra Tamayo – Chief Operating Officer
Business Administrator, graduated from Universidad Jorge Tadeo Lozano, with a master’s degree in business from Universidad Sergio Arboleda - Prime Business School (in process of graduation). He has extensive experience in BBVA in his 23 years of work; he has led in the Credit Factory of Individuals and operational processes in the last 5 years and currently serves as Director of Operations.
Pedro Antonio Díaz Sáenz – Legal Director Banking Business
Lawyer from Universidad Nacional de Colombia, with a specialization in Financial Law from Universidad del Rosario and specialist in Procedural Law from the same university, diplomas and courses in Management and conciliator. With extensive experience in the financial sector, where he has worked as a lawyer for Banco Andino, Head of Commercial Development and currently holds the position of Head of Legal Banking Business.
Néstor Orlando Prieto Ballén - Legal Director of Litigation
Lawyer from the Universidad Libre, with specializations in Procedural Law and Civil Law from the Universidad del Rosario, with diplomas and courses in senior management from INALDE and conciliation course from the Chamber of Commerce of Bogotá. Member of the Colombian Institute of Procedural Law and University Professor. With extensive experience in the financial sector, where he has worked as a lawyer of Corporación y Vivienda Las Villas, lawyer of Banco Industrial Colombiano (later merged by Bancolombia), lawyer of Bancolombia; he currently holds the position of Head of Legal Litigation of BBVA Colombia.
William Fredy Rincón Vargas - Director of Legal Services CIB & Treasury
Lawyer graduated from Universidad Nacional de Colombia, with specialization in Financial Law from Universidad de los Andes and in Commercial Law from Universidad Javeriana. He has extensive professional experience in the financial, commercial and stock market sectors, in the areas of banking, investment banking, capital markets, treasury, public securities market and corporations.
Alejandra Raquel Llerena Polo - Director of Labor Law Counsel
Lawyer from Universidad Externado de Colombia, with specialization in Labor Law and Industrial Relations from the same University and in Commercial Law from Universidad Santo Tomás. She has been linked to the 9th Labor Court of the circuit of Bogota, in the Central Mortgage Bank in Liquidation as an advisor on labor issues; later she was linked to SENA as a Professional in Human Management, in Colsubsidio as Head of Labor Relations and joined BBVA as a Labor Lawyer. She currently holds the position of Director of Labor Legal Counsel.
John Jairo Martínez Gómez – Markets Administrator
Public Accountant from Universidad Santo Tomás specialized in Finance and Capital Markets at Universidad de La Sabana, with extensive experience and knowledge in the management of fixed income and derivatives portfolio valuation, accounting and investment regulations, derivatives, own position in foreign currency and treasury operational controls. He has served as Head of the Valuation Operations Department - Treasury Operations, Accounting Coordinator of the Murex Project, Accounting Coordinator of Investments, Derivatives and Foreign Currency at Banco Davivienda. Currently, he is the Manager of Market Administration.
Diego Felipe Riveros Riveros – Head of Wealth Management
Industrial Engineer from Universidad de Los Andes, with a specialization in Finance and a master’s degree in administration from the same University. He has more than 20 years of experience in the financial sector, where he has served as Quality Manager, Operations Manager, Foreign Product Manager, Investment Manager, Vice President of Investments, Vice President of Wealth Management and Vice President of Wealth and Insurance at Citibank Group; at Scotiabank Colpatria he was Insurance and Private Banking Manager and at Scotia Securities he was General Manager; again at Scotiabank he was Wealth Management Manager; currently he is the Director of Wealth Management at BBVA Colombia.
Diana Carolina Del Mar Ramírez López – Director of SDA Strategy and Data CIB
Economist with master’s in economy from Universidad de los Andes and MBA from London Business School. She has experience in strategic design, asset and liabilities management in financial entities, macroeconomic analysis and economic consultancy to foreign and local investors related to economics and investment strategy. She has extensive experience in the financial sector, where she has hold as Chief of economics research in Santander, Colombia; Financial Institutions Group (FIG) Associate in Santander, New York and LatAm FX strategist in Morgan Stanley in New York. At BBVA Colombia, she served as Market Strategist for Colombia and Peru and Director of Financial Management. She currently serves as Director of SDA Strategy and Data CIB at BBVA Colombia.
Natalia Martínez Simmonds - Head of Global Transactional Banking
Degree in business administration from Universidad Del Rosario with emphasis in finance. She has develop a success career of more than 17 years in BBVA, mostly in Transaction Banking Global team, and before in Global Markets. Currently she holds the position of Head of Global Transactional Banking in BBVA Colombia.
Mónica Osorno Chaparro - Director of Institutional Banking
Economist of the “Universidad de Buenaventura” with financial specialization program of the Pontificia Universidad Javeriana and MBA of the Universidad Sergio Arboleda. She has 21 years of experience in BBVA Colombia, where she has served as Institutional and Corporate Banking Executive and Corporate Banking Manager. Currently she is Director of Institutional Banking.
July Carolina Miranda Blanco – Tax Management Manager
A Certified Public Accountant specialized in tax law from the University of the Andes, she has led teams in accounting and taxation, financial and tax reporting, preparation and submission of financial statements, regulatory reporting, and audit processes. She has expertise in the national tax system, district regulations, and reporting exogenous information for DIAN and UGPP, including compliance with FATCA and CRS regulations.
Claudia Patricia Quiroz Pérez – Director of Supervisor Relations, Strategy, and People
An economist with over 20 years of experience in the financial sector, specializing in Internal Control and Operational Risk within business areas and the credit lifecycle for payroll loans. She has expertise in applying agile methodologies for developing projects and initiatives related to product launches, processes, services, third-party management, and operational risk assessment. Additionally, she has experience in documenting control frameworks for various risk types and overseeing regulatory compliance.
Carlos Gabriel García Baena - Director de Financial Planning, Profitability & Capital
Age Range 25 – 35 years old
Master's degree in Financial Markets and Administration, with more than 10 years of experience in the banking and construction sectors, transforming and optimizing results in the areas of financial planning and strategy, financial data (advanced analytics), processes, project management, internal control, and agile. He is an empathetic, practical, proactive, results-focused leader with great communication and teamwork skills and an ability to adapt easily to change. He is an expert in banking, corporate finance, and financial markets.
Mónica Zamudio Medina – Legal Representative in her capacity as Director of High-Value Individuals
With over 15 years of experience in the financial sector, she has led comprehensive retail banking strategies in Colombia and Central America, with a focus on value creation and excellence. She holds a degree in Industrial Engineering with a specialization in Strategic Management from Universidad de La Sabana, a Master’s in Mobile Business from the University of Barcelona, and is currently an MBA candidate at IE Business School in Madrid. She has extensive knowledge in media, advertising, marketing, and digital banking transformation. She has managed strategies for credit and liability products, leading key segments such as payroll and high-value clients. Currently, she heads the deposits and high-value clients business at BBVA Colombia, driving innovative solutions that strengthen the bank’s positioning among savers and investors. She is recognized for her strategic vision and results-oriented approach.
Olga Esperanza Serna Ramírez – Legal Representative in her capacity as Director of Investment and Cost
A professional in Finance and International Relations from Universidad Externado, with a specialization in Actuarial Science, an MBA in Quantitative Finance and Management from New York University, and currently a candidate for a specialization in Financial and Securities Regulation. She has extensive experience in the financial sector, having held key roles at BBVA Colombia such as Head of Investment and Cost Management and Principal Economist at BBVA Research. She also served at the Financial Institutions Guarantee Fund (FOGAFIN), where she led the Deposit Insurance System and risk assessment areas. Additionally, she has worked at Prudential Financial and the Central Bank of Colombia.
Carolina Galvis – Director of Engineering Strategy and Control
An Industrial Engineer with a specialization in Business Administration and a Master’s in Finance, she has over 20 years of experience leading financial, technological, and strategic planning initiatives in companies within the financial and service sectors. Her previous roles include Manager Advisor for Finance at Ernst & Young, Financial Planning Manager at Colsubsidio, and Strategic Senior Manager at BBVA Colombia. She currently serves as Director of Engineering Strategy and Control at BBVA Colombia and is a member of the Board of Directors of Redeban.
Daniel Patrón García - Director of Asset Liability Management (ALM).
Professional in Economics and Industrial Engineering, with a Master’s degree in Finance from Universidad de los Andes. He has more than 14 years of professional experience in the financial market and solid expertise in market management and balance sheet management strategies. He currently serves as the Director of Asset Liability Management (ALM).
Juan Fernando Gómez Posada – Treasurer
Age Range: 50 – 60 years
Business Administrator from Universidad EAFIT, with a specialization in Corporate Finance from "Colegio de Estudios Superiores de Administración" (CESA). He brings capital markets experience from banks such as Citibank, Bancolombia, Banco de Bogotá, and JPMorgan. He currently serves as Head of Global Markets and Treasurer of BBVA Colombia.
Jorge Andrés Murcia Pulido – Director of General Secretariat & M&A
Attorney graduated from Universidad Externado de Colombia, holding a specialization in Financial Law from Universidad de los Andes and a Master's Degree (LL.M.) in Private Law from the same institution. Additionally, he brings extensive experience in the financial sector, having served in positions such as Legal Manager at MC Assets S.A.S. – a Colpatria Group Company, General Secretariat Manager at Scotiabank Colpatria S.A., and AML Compliance Officer & International Operations Leader at Banco Colpatria Cayman Inc. He currently serves as Director of General Secretariat & M&A at BBVA Colombia.
